blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Makabayan bloc lawmakers urged the House Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee (BARSc) to prioritize education, government employees, social services, and agriculture as it begins deliberations on amendments to the 2027 national budget bill. The House of Representatives wrapped up its plenary deliberations on the P7.2-trillion budget bill last week. The BARSc, composed of select lawmakers from major political parties and the minority bloc, will discuss the proposed amendments lawmakers are expected to introduce on Thursday, Oct. 1.
